prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 2024年重点信息化项目执行情况汇总表 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 5 columns × 6 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "项目" · longest unbreakable word 22px · one-line width 215px
  col 2: header "负责人" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 46px
  col 3: header "预算（万元）" · longest unbreakable word 60px · one-line width 92px
  col 4: header "进度" · longest unbreakable word 48px · one-line width 373px
  col 5: header "风险说明" · longest unbreakable word 38px · one-line width 1830px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"2024年重点信息化项目执行情况汇总表，用于按项目快速了解负责人、预算、进度与风险，支持管理审阅和横向比较。","reading":"以行为单位先定位项目，再扫读负责人、预算和进度；预算需要纵向比较，进度和风险用于发现异常，风险说明通常在最后细读。","groups":["项目+负责人：项目身份与责任归属，应相邻阅读","预算+进度：执行度量，适合并排比较","风险说明：独立的问题叙述列，承载长文本"],"keep_intact":["预算金额（含千分位与两位小数）","负责人姓名","短进度状态词（如“已完成”）","表头文字与“一网通办”等固定说法"],"may_wrap":["较长的项目名称（按中文词边界换行）","较长的进度描述","风险说明长文本"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r0A: widths [74, 66, 81, 69, 69] · table 360×4287px · row heights [83, 943, 734, 734, 804, 990] · column headers wrapped 3/5 · tallest cell 42 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0B: widths [100, 56, 81, 63, 59] · table 360×6287px · row heights [83, 1408, 1106, 1129, 1129, 1431] · column headers wrapped 3/5 · tallest cell 61 lines · mid-word splits 1
Design r0C: widths [68, 60, 81, 66, 84] · table 360×3288px · row heights [83, 734, 548, 571, 594, 757] · column headers wrapped 2/5 · tallest cell 32 lines · mid-word splits 1

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r0A","good":"预算列 81px 能完整容纳“1,280.00”（需 60px 内容宽），项目列 74px 让 11 字项目名在 4 行内断行，行首识别不错。","problems":"负责人被拆成“李建/国”三行竖排，姓名可读性丧失；风险说明只有 69px，导致最高单元格 42 行、整表 4287px；进度列 69px 每行仅 3 字，读成一条竖排字带，几乎无法扫读。表头 3/5 换行，“预算（万/元）”也很难看。","cause":"col2=66 时内容宽恰为 45px，等于三个汉字宽度，无任何余量，浏览器按字断行；同时 col1(74)、col4(69) 吃掉了本应给 col5 的宽度，而 col5 的 1830px 文本每增加 1px 可省约 8px 行高，是收益最高的一列，却拿了最少。"},{"design":"r0B","good":"项目列 100px 让长项目名断行最整齐（3 行），表头“项目”单行。","problems":"最差方案：风险说明 59px，最高单元格 61 行，整表 6287px，需要滚十几屏；出现 1 处词内断裂；进度列 63px 同样成竖条。","cause":"把 40px 额外宽度投给了最不需要的 col1（项目名总共才 215px，一次换行就够），而 col5 被压到 59px（内容 38px，约 2.5 字/行），行高按 1/(w−21) 急剧膨胀。"},{"design":"r0C","good":"三者中最好：风险列 84px（内容 63px，约 4 字/行）把整表压到 3288px，最高单元格 32 行；项目、进度、风险三列宽度比例接近合理。","problems":"负责人列 60px → 内容 39px < 45px，姓名仍被拆（词内断裂 1 处）；预算列 81px 让“1,280.00”零余量贴边，表头“预算（万元）”挤成 3 行；进度列 66px 仍是 3 字/行的竖条。","cause":"col2 低于 68px 的硬下限（3 汉字 45px + 21px 内边距），col3 恰好卡在 60px 临界值，宽度分配没有给这两列留安全余量，也没有继续把宽度让给收益最高的 col5。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"fix-r0C","widths":[60,70,84,61,84],"change":"以 r0C 为基础，把负责人从 60 提到 70（内容 49px > 45px，三字姓名不再拆行），预算从 81 提到 84 给“1,280.00”留余量、表头降为 2 行；这 13px 全部从项目(−8)和进度(−5)挪出，风险列保持 84px 不动，因此总高度不增、词内断裂归零。"},{"name":"risk-lean","widths":[60,70,84,55,90],"change":"在 fix-r0C 上再向风险列倾斜 6px（84→90，内容 69px，约 4.6 字/行），代价是进度列降到 55px（内容 34px，仍可容纳“进度”表头单行）。因为风险文本 1830px 是进度 373px 的近 5 倍，每 1px 给风险列省下的行高约是给进度列的 1.6 倍，整表更短而信息不丢。"},{"name":"risk-max","widths":[58,70,84,52,95],"change":"激进版：风险列给到 95px（内容 74px，约 5 字/行，最长单元格约 24 行），负责人/预算守住 70/84 的完整性下限，项目 58px、进度 52px 只保证两字表头不换行、正文成窄条。适用于“先看风险叙述”的审阅场景，用前两列的窄换取整表高度再降约 20%。"}],"done":false}
